import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile

from probe import status
warm = {'loop_running':True,'listener':True}
assert status('ready',warm) == 503
assert status('ready',dict(warm,restored=False)) == 503
assert status('ready',dict(warm,restored=True)) == 200
assert status('ready',dict(warm,restored=True,listener=False)) == 503

assert status('live',warm) == 200
